claims.text: MultiLLM-Chatbot is a scalable RAG-based benchmarking framework designed to evaluate language models across multiple domain-specific applications.
LLAMA-3.3-70B was the overall best-performing model among the evaluated language models.
LLAMA-3.3-70B led performance across all five evaluated domains.

evidence.description: This paper introduces MultiLLM-Chatbot, a scalable RAG-based benchmarking framework designed to evaluate five popular LLMs across five domains.
Experimental results show LLAMA-3.3-70B as the overall best-performing model.
Experimental results show LLAMA-3.3-70B leading in all 5 domains.

methodologies.name: MultiLLM-Chatbot Framework
methodologies.description: A scalable RAG-based benchmarking framework that evaluates LLMs using Elasticsearch retrieval, sentence-transformer embeddings, and multi-metric analysis (cosine similarity, VADER sentiment, TF-IDF, NER).
datasets: 50 peer-reviewed research papers across 5 domains (250 standardized queries, 1250 model responses)

limitations.text: Challenges such as semantic similarity, bias/sentiment, and hallucinations persist, especially in domain-specific applications.
